verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms that a live llms.txt exists at developer.clickup.com (HTTP 200, with a ClickUp Documentation header). The developer docs are also served as raw .md pages covering authentication, tasks, views, comments and MCP setup, which are directly consumable by an agent, and a raw OpenAPI spec is documented per API version. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or comprehensive llms.txt coverage beyond the header, the OpenAPI spec at standard discoverable paths (probes 404'd), and independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.
